GRP-POL-001|Version6.0|Internal

## 11. Risk assessment methodology

## 11.1Scoring

Risk is scored as theproductof impact and likelihood,each ratedon a five-point scale,producing a scorebetween1and25whichmaps to oneoffivebands.Thesame scale appliesto inherentandresidualassessments and toeveryriskcategory, sothat aHighrating means the same thing in credit risk as in technologyrisk.

Risk Rating Matrix-Inherent and Residual Scoring Severe (5)10152025121620SACA Moderate (3)391215Minor (2)2810Insignificant 12345(1)
Rare Unlikely Fossible Likely Almost certain (1)(2)(3)(4)(5)
LIKELIHOOD Low(1-3)Moderate (4-7)Elevated(8-12）High(13-19)Critical（20-25）

Figure 7 — Risk rating matrix. Scale definitions are at Appendix A.

11.2 Rating bands and required response

| BAND | SCORE | DECISIONAUTHORITY | REQUIREDRESPONSE Immediate treatment plan; Board notified within 24 hours; monthly reporting until |
|---|---|---|---|
| Critical | 20-25 | Board Risk Committee | residualfallsbelowCritical |
| High | 13-19 | Group ExecutiveRiskCommittee | Treatment plan within10 business days;monthly tracking; second-line challenge mandatory |
| Elevated | 8-12 | DivisionalRiskCommittee | Treatment plan within 20 business days;quarterly tracking |
| Moderate | 4-7 | Risk owner | Manage throughbusiness-as-usual controls; review at nextRcsA |
| Low | 1-3 | Control owner | Accept and monitor; no treatment planreguired |

11.3 Control effectiveness assessment

| RATING | DEFINITION | EFFECTONRESIDUALSCORE |
|---|---|---|
| Effective | Design is appropriate and the control operated as intended throughout theperiod,evidencedbytesting | Fullreduction from inherent permitted |
| Partially effective | Design is appropriatebutoperationwasinconsistent. or a design gap is mitigated by compensating controls | Partialreduction:an issue mustberaised |
| Ineffective | Design is inadequate,or thecontroldidnotoperate | No reduction:residual eguals inherent: issueraised atminimum Elevated |
| Not assessed | No testing performed in the period | No reliance permitted: treated as ineffective forrating purposes |

Evidence requirement. A residual rating lower than the inherent rating must be supported by retained evidence of control testing and, if unresolved, the residual rating is restated to the inherent rating. performed within the preceding twelve months. Unevidenced assertions of control effectiveness will be challenged by the second line
